purpose: 10-task protocol-validation paired A/B pilot; not an efficacy estimate

dataset.name: princeton-nlp/SWE-bench_Verified
dataset.sampling_note: Fixed-seed Windows-native convenience sample; not representative of all SWE-bench Verified tasks.

apparatus.arm_b: isolated CODEX_HOME with frozen current Masters' Nudge hooks
apparatus.source_preflight: 309 tests passed, 2 skipped; plugin runtime synchronized
apparatus.network_policy: Prompt forbids external task research; both arms have identical process permissions.

scoring.evaluator: Fresh base checkout, model product-code diff only, then official test patch
scoring.test_file_policy: Run every test file or Django test label modified by the official test patch
scoring.pass_rule: Evaluator command exits 0 after the test patch is applied
scoring.inference: Descriptive paired table and exact McNemar/sign-test diagnostics only; n=10 is not a stable effect estimate.

exclusion_and_replacement.pre_arm_preflight: Apply official test patch to the base checkout and require a completed, non-passing native test command.
exclusion_and_replacement.replacement: If checkout, dependency setup, test-patch application, or baseline-failure reproduction is unavailable on Windows, record an infrastructure exclusion and take the next fixed-seed-ranked eligible instance.
exclusion_and_replacement.post_arm: Once either arm starts, retain the task in the denominator. Runtime/setup failures are reported separately and are not silently replaced.
exclusion_and_replacement.no_rerun_rule: Do not rerun a completed model arm for a different answer. Evaluator-only infrastructure errors may be corrected against the unchanged model diff.
